# Atmos Paragliding

> Tandem paragliding flights in Ölüdeniz, Turkey, launching from Babadağ Mountain (1960m) over the Blue Lagoon. Fully certified and insured pilots, 25+ years of combined experience, 4.9/5 average rating across 2,400+ reviews.

Atmos Paragliding operates daily tandem paragliding flights from Babadağ Mountain above Ölüdeniz and the Blue Lagoon, on the Turquoise Coast near Fethiye, Turkey. Every tandem flight is one fixed price of $150 per person, all-inclusive: hotel pickup and mountain transfer, Babadağ entrance fee, all safety equipment, insurance, a licensed SHGM-certified tandem pilot, and a professional HD photo & video package. No add-ons, no group discounts, no hidden fees; free rescheduling or full refund if weather cancels a flight. Flights run daily in season (best conditions April–October). Options include standard tandem flights, sunset flights, cross-country (XC) flights for licensed pilots, acro flights, paramotor flights, and group bookings.

- [Tandem Paragliding](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/tandem-paragliding): standard tandem flight details
- [Babadağ Guide](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/babadag-guide): the launch mountain, takeoff points, cable car
- [Safety Record](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/safety-record): certifications and safety information
- [FAQ](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/faq): common questions
- [Reviews](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/reviews): customer reviews
- [Contact](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/contact): contact details and location
